# Exploring Patterns of Environmental Justice

## Introduction

## Load Packages
```{r}
#| results: hide
# Load packages
install.packages("gt")
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(here)
library(gt)
```

## Import data

Import EJ Screen data:
```{r}
# Read in geodatabase of EJScreen data at the Census Block Group level
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "ejscreen","EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb"))

# Filter to Los Angeles County
los_angeles <- ejscreen |> 
  dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Los Angeles County"))

```

Import HOLC Redlining data for Los Angeles:
```{r}
# Read in HOLC Redlining data for Los Angeles
redline <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "mapping-inequality", "mapping-inequality-los-angeles.json"))

# Check CRS of redline against los_angeles
if(st_crs(redline) == st_crs(los_angeles)) {
  print('CRS match')
}else{
  warning('CRS do not match')
  print(paste('redline CRS is', st_crs(redline)))
  print(paste('ej screen CRS is', st_crs(los_angeles)))
}
```

Match HOLC Redlining data to the coordinate reference system for EJ Screen data:
```{r}
# Change redline CRS to match los_angeles
redline <- st_transform(redline, crs = st_crs(los_angeles))

# Check CRS of redline
if(st_crs(redline) == st_crs(los_angeles)) {
  print('CRS match')
}else{
  warning('CRS do not match')
  print(paste('redline CRS is', st_crs(redline)))
  print(paste('ej screen CRS is', st_crs(los_angeles)))
}
```

Import bike and pedestrian crash report data:
```{r}
# Read in bike and pedestrian crash report data
crash <- read_csv(here::here("data", "SWITRS_LA", "crashes.csv"))

# Check for NA values in coordinate columns
print(paste('There are', sum(is.na(crash$LATITUDE)), 'NA values in the LATITUDE column'))
print(paste('There are', sum(is.na(crash$LONGITUDE)), 'NA values in the LONGITUDE column'))
print(paste('There are', sum(is.na(crash$POINT_Y)), 'NA values in the POINT_Y column'))
print(paste('There are', sum(is.na(crash$POINT_X)), 'NA values in the POINT_X column'))
```

Clean latitude and longitude columns and set coordinate reference system to match HOLC Redlining data and EJ Screen data:
```{r}
# Create dataframe of crash columns containing latitude and longitude data
crash_lat_long <- crash[c("LATITUDE", "POINT_Y", "LONGITUDE", "POINT_X")]

# Replace NAs in LATITUDE with POINT_Y values and NAs in LONGITUDE with POINT_X values 
crash_lat_long <- crash_lat_long |> 
  mutate(combined_lat = (
    ifelse(is.na(crash_lat_long$LATITUDE), crash_lat_long$POINT_Y, crash_lat_long$LATITUDE))) |> # If value in LATITUDE column is NA, replace with POINT_Y value, otherwise keep LATITUDE value 
  mutate(combined_long = (
    ifelse(is.na(crash_lat_long$LONGITUDE), crash_lat_long$POINT_X, crash_lat_long$LONGITUDE)
  )) # If value in LONGITUDE column is NA, replace with POINT_X value, otherwise keep LONGITUDE value 

# Add cleaned combined lat and long columns to crash dataframe
crash_clean_coords <- crash |> 
  mutate(LONGITUDE = crash_lat_long$combined_long,
         LATITUDE = crash_lat_long$combined_lat) |> 
  select(c(-POINT_X, -POINT_Y)) |> # remove old POINT_X and POINT_Y columns
  drop_na(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE) |> # drop rows with NA latitude or longitude 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE"), crs = 4326) |> # set CRS to recognize longitude and latitude
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(los_angeles)) # transform CRS to match ejscreen and redline data

# Check that all CRS match
if((st_crs(redline) == st_crs(crash_clean_coords)) & (st_crs(los_angeles) == st_crs(crash_clean_coords))) {
  print('CRS match')
}else{
  warning('CRS do not match')}
```

## Part 1: Legacy of redlining in current environmental (in)justice

### Map of historical redlining neighborhoods in Los Angeles:
```{r}
redline_neighborhoods <- tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap") +
  tm_graticules() +
  tm_shape(redline) + # Add historical redlining data
  tm_polygons(fill = "grade", lwd = 0.5,
              fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(
                  values = c('green3', 'yellow1', 'orange1', 'red2')),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "HOLC Grade",
                                      position = tm_pos_out('right'))) +
  tm_compass(position = c('left', 'bottom'), # Add compass
                size = 2) +
    tm_scalebar(position = c('right', 'bottom')) + # Add scalebar
    tm_title('Historical Redlining Neighborhoods in Los Angeles',
              fontface = 'bold')

redline_neighborhoods
```

### Census block groups and HOLC grades in Los Angeles:
```{r}
# Join redlining data and EJ Screen data
los_angeles_redline <- st_join(los_angeles, redline, join = st_intersects)
```

```{r}
# Summarize percentage of census block groups within each HOLC grade for LA County
HOLC_block_groups <- los_angeles_redline |>  
  st_drop_geometry() |> # Drop geometries to convert to standard dataframe 
  mutate(Grade = grade) |> 
  group_by(Grade) |> 
  mutate(Grade = replace_na(Grade, "No Grade Assigned")) |> 
  summarize(`Block Count` = n()) |> 
  mutate(`Percentage of Census Blocks` = (`Block Count` / sum(`Block Count`)) * 100)

HOLC_block_groups |> 
  gt()
```

### Summarize particulate matter 2.5 percentiles and % low income by HOLC grade:
```{r}
# Summarize Particulate Matter 2.5 percentiles by HOLC grade
HOLC_PM25 <- los_angeles_redline |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> # Drop geometries to convert to standard dataframe 
  group_by(grade) |>  
  summarize(Mean_PM25_Percentile = mean(P_PM25)) |> 
  mutate(grade = replace_na(grade, "No Grade Assigned")) 

# Summarize % low income by HOLC grade
HOLC_low_income <- los_angeles_redline |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> # Drop geometries to convert to standard dataframe 
  group_by(grade) |>  
  summarize(Mean_Pct_Low_Income = (mean(LOWINCPCT) * 100)) |> 
  mutate(grade = replace_na(grade, "No Grade Assigned")) 
```

### Visualize particulate matter 2.5 percentiles by HOLC grade:
```{r}
ggplot(HOLC_PM25, aes(x = grade, y = Mean_PM25_Percentile, fill = as.factor(grade))) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("A" = 'green3', "B" = 'yellow1', "C" = 'orange1', "D" = 'red2', "No Grade Assigned" = "ivory2")) + # Assign appropriate colors to HOLC grades
    labs(
        title = "Particulate Matter 2.5 Percentiles in Los Angeles \nby HOLC Grade",
        x = "HOLC Grade",
        y = "Mean Particulate 2.5 Percentile",
        fill = "HOLC Grade"
    ) +
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "azure1"))
```

### Visualize % low income by HOLC grade:
```{r}
ggplot(HOLC_low_income, aes(x = grade, y = Mean_Pct_Low_Income, fill = as.factor(grade))) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("A" = 'green3', "B" = 'yellow1', "C" = 'orange1', "D" = 'red2', "No Grade Assigned" = "ivory2")) + # Assign appropriate colors to HOLC grades
    labs(
        title = "Percentage of Low Income Los Angeles Residents \nby HOLC Grade",
        x = "HOLC Grade",
        y = "Mean Percentage of Low Income Residents",
        fill = "HOLC Grade"
    ) +
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "azure1"))
```

## Part 2: Legacy of redlining in pedestrian and bike accidents

### Summarize percent of pedestrian and bicylce accidents in Los Angeles county by HOLC grade


Create a dataframe of pedestrian and bicycle accidents using crashes data:
```{r}
# Filter crashes to include pedestrian and bicycle accidents
bike_and_ped_accidents <- crash_clean_coords |> 
  select(c(PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT, BICYCLE_ACCIDENT, COUNT_PED_INJURED, COUNT_PED_KILLED, COUNT_BICYCLIST_INJURED, COUNT_BICYCLIST_KILLED)) |> 
  filter(PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT == "Y" | BICYCLE_ACCIDENT == "Y") # Keep rows where pedestrian or bike accidents are marked Y

# Check that CRS matches redlining data
if(st_crs(bike_and_ped_accidents) == st_crs(redline)) {
  print('CRS match')
}else{
  warning('CRS do not match')
  print(paste('bike_and_ped_accidents CRS is', st_crs(bike_and_ped_accidents)))
  print(paste('redline CRS is', st_crs(redline)))
}
```

Join pedestrian and bicycle data and redline data:
```{r}
# Join bike and pedestrian accident data and redline data
redline_crashes <- st_join(bike_and_ped_accidents, redline)
```

Summarize percent of pedestrian and bicycle accidents by HOLC grade:
```{r}
# Summarize percentage of pedestrian accidents within each HOLC grade
HOLC_ped_accidents <- redline_crashes |>  
  st_drop_geometry() |> # Drop geometries to convert to standard dataframe 
  select(PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT, grade) |> 
  drop_na(PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT) |> # Remove NA pedestrian accident values
  mutate(Grade = grade) |> 
  group_by(Grade) |> 
  summarize(`Pedestrian Crashes Count` = n()) |> 
  mutate(`Percentage of Pedestrian Crashes` = (`Pedestrian Crashes Count` / sum(`Pedestrian Crashes Count`)) * 100) |> 
  mutate(Grade = replace_na(Grade, "No Grade Assigned")) 

# Summarize percentage of bike accidents within each HOLC grade
HOLC_bike_accidents <- redline_crashes |>  
  st_drop_geometry() |> # Drop geometries to convert to standard dataframe 
  select(BICYCLE_ACCIDENT, grade) |> 
  drop_na(BICYCLE_ACCIDENT) |> # Remove NA bicycle accident values
  mutate(Grade = grade) |> 
  group_by(Grade) |> 
  summarize(`Bike Crashes Count` = n()) |> 
  mutate(`Percentage of Bike Crashes` = (`Bike Crashes Count` / sum(`Bike Crashes Count`)) * 100) |> 
  mutate(Grade = replace_na(Grade, "No Grade Assigned")) 

# Join bike and pedestrian crash information by HOLC grade
HOLC_bike_and_ped_accidents <- inner_join(HOLC_bike_accidents, HOLC_ped_accidents, by = "Grade")

# Add column to joined data to show total bike and pedestrian accidents
HOLC_bike_and_ped_accidents$`Total Crashes` <- HOLC_bike_and_ped_accidents$`Bike Crashes Count` + HOLC_bike_and_ped_accidents$`Pedestrian Crashes Count`

# Add column to joined data to show percentages of total bike and pedestrian accidents
HOLC_bike_and_ped_accidents$`Percentage of Total Crashes` <- HOLC_bike_and_ped_accidents$`Total Crashes` / sum(HOLC_bike_and_ped_accidents$`Total Crashes`) * 100

HOLC_bike_and_ped_accidents |> 
  gt()
```

### Visualize the percentage of pedestrian and bicylce accidents within each HOLC grade

```{r}
ggplot(HOLC_bike_and_ped_accidents, aes(x = Grade, y = `Percentage of Total Crashes`, fill = as.factor(Grade))) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("A" = 'green3', "B" = 'yellow1', "C" = 'orange1', "D" = 'red2', "No Grade Assigned" = "ivory2")) + # Assign appropriate colors to HOLC grades
    labs(
        title = "Percentage of Pedestrian and Bicycle Accidents \nin Los Angeles by HOLC Grade",
        x = "HOLC Grade",
        y = "Percentage of Bike and Pedestrian Accidents",
        fill = "HOLC Grade"
    ) +
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "azure1"))
```
